title: Trump says US forces are ’clearing’ Strait of Hormuz
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump on ​Saturday posted on social media that the United States ‌military has started to clear the Strait of Hormuz, and that all of Iran’s minelaying ships have been sunk.

title: Iran threatens to attack US Navy ships entering Strait of Hormuz after first US vessels moved through channel
byline: Iran threatened to attack any US Navy ships that enter the Strait of Hormuz shortly after American vessels moved through the channel for the first time since the war broke out.

title: Iranian negotiators in Pakistan ‘defending Iran’s interests’: Pezeshkian
byline: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has expressed support for the Iranian negotiators in Pakistan, saying the delegation will “negotiate bravely” in defence of the country’s interests.

title: CID seals Lanka Coal Company office
byline: Officials attached to the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) have sealed the office of Lanka Coal Company (Pvt.) Ltd. as part of an ongoing investigation into coal imports.

title: Rubio says revoked visas of ex-Iranian vice president’s relatives
byline: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says he has revoked the residency statuses of several individuals related to Iran’s former Vice President for Women and Family Affairs, Masoumeh Ebtekar.

title: Police introduce WhatsApp number to report reckless driving
byline: Police have introduced a dedicated WhatsApp number for the public to submit videos and information related to reckless and dangerous driving incidents.

title: Kamala Harris says she is considering 2028 presidential run
byline: Former US Vice President Kamala Harris said on Friday that she is considering a presidential run in 2028, implying that she may run for president for the third time.

title: Trilateral US-Iran ceasefire talks begin in Pakistan
byline: Trilateral ceasefire talks between the United States, Iran and Pakistan have started in Pakistani capital, Islamabad – the highest-level talks between Washington and Tehran since the 1979 Islamic revolution.

title: Trump says empty oil tankers heading to U.S. to load up with oil, gas
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said on ​Saturday that large numbers of completely empty ‌oil tankers were heading to the United States to load up with oil and gas.
